title: ReferenceServiceAreaStatusChangedPayload
description: Payload of `reference.service_area.status_changed` version 1: a service area's status changed; `effectively_active` says whether it and every ancestor are active after the change. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

effectively_active.description: Whether it and every ancestor are active.
